title: Investment vs. Speculative Grade Classification
user_story: As a portfolio manager, I want each rating classified as Investment Grade or Speculative Grade so that I can enforce mandate limits.

acceptance_criteria.text: Ratings of Baa3 (MOODYS) / BBB- (FITCH) or higher are classified as INVESTMENT_GRADE.
Ratings of Ba1 (MOODYS) / BB+ (FITCH) or lower, including C, RD and D, are classified as SPECULATIVE_GRADE.
Fitch-style RD and D are additionally flagged in_default=true. All other ratings have in_default=false.
Status codes WR, WD and NR are classified as NOT_RATED.
When an issuer has one INVESTMENT_GRADE and one SPECULATIVE_GRADE rating from different agencies, the issuer is flagged split_rated=true; otherwise split_rated=false.
